prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a person’s hands holding a sleek, modern tablet device in landscape orientation, with the screen displaying a video game interface. The game interface features a dark, moody color palette dominated by deep reds and blacks, with a virtual joystick and control buttons overlaid on the lower half of the screen, and a gritty, urban environment visible in the background of the game. The hands are well-lit, with soft, diffused lighting casting a gentle pink and blue glow, suggesting a high-tech or gaming environment. The background is softly blurred, with hints of a notepad, pen, and colorful objects on a white desk, creating a sense of depth and focus on the tablet. The overall style is modern and immersive, with a shallow depth of field and a slightly elevated camera angle, evoking the intimate, concentrated atmosphere of late-night gaming or tech exploration.
